purpose: Add inert physical inventory movement persistence for canonical immutable single-version assertions, without operational authority.

migration.schemaChanges: None; no new migration, amendment, or index.
migration.migration 0004: Reused unchanged and unexecuted; sufficient existing movement columns, primary key, batch foreign key, and immutable triggers.

persistence.interface: Narrow local structural prepare/bind/all interface; no broad runtime globals.
persistence.identity: Global caller-supplied movement ID; intrinsically single-version immutable evidence. No movement version, revision, timestamp, or mutable state.

outcomes.created: This insert returned exactly one valid canonical row equal to the complete requested movement.
outcomes.already-present: Exact movement ID exists with identical canonical payload.
outcomes.conflict: Exact movement ID exists with divergent canonical payload.
outcomes.invalid: Caller movement fails canonical validation, referenced exact durable batch is missing, or movement SKU differs from durable batch SKU.
outcomes.storage-failure: Malformed durable movement/batch, failed or uncertain storage read, impossible insert witness, or unresolved insert failure. Raw database exceptions are not exposed.

persistence.ordering: Validate caller, read exact movement ID first, classify existing canonical evidence, then validate batch only for an absent ID. An exact retry needs no batch read; divergent same-ID retries conflict before new-entry checks.
persistence.batchBinding: Read exact batch_id/version, reconstruct the full canonical FoodProductionBatchVersion and validate through validateFoodProductionBatchVersion. Compare both SKU ID and SKU version before INSERT. Wrong returned batch identity and malformed/uncertain rows fail closed as storage-failure.
persistence.nonFrozenBatch: SQL frozen_on null reconstructs frozenOn omission; canonical W1 validation is reused without business-validation duplication.
persistence.movementReconstruction: Reconstruct every canonical movement field from selected columns and reuse validateFoodPhysicalInventoryMovement; no coercion or silently dropped malformed rows.
persistence.insert: Parameterized INSERT VALUES RETURNING only. Exactly one matching valid witness is required for created. No updates, deletes, replacements, or mutable upsert.
persistence.raceRecovery: After INSERT exception/failed storage result, reread exact movement ID only. Identical canonical row yields already-present; divergent yields conflict; missing, malformed, wrong identity, or uncertain read yields storage-failure. Batch validation is not rerun as race authority.
persistence.references: No latest/current resolution, history scan, aggregate query, or implicit identity generation.
persistence.immutability: Canonical reconstructed snapshots and nested batch/SKU references are detached and frozen. Production-batch rows are never mutated.

corrections.policy: Preserve original movement evidence. Future operational corrections may create a new explicitly attributed compensating movement where existing canonical types represent it.
examples: Incorrect adjustment-out may be compensated by adjustment-in.
Incorrect adjustment-in may be compensated by adjustment-out.
corrections.boundary: No reversal, void, correction, superseded, or cancelled types. No structured correction linkage is inferred from sourceReference.

notAuthority: Repository does not authenticate callers or prove administrator identity; authentication remains above persistence.
Persistence validates structure and exact durable binding, not physical event truth, source truth, or operational permission.
Repository does not enforce nonnegative stock; negative stock prevention belongs to later trusted execution with an atomic database balance guard.
No QOH calculation, projection, current-state storage, or sufficient-stock check.
No stocked SKU capacity writes or availability derivation.
Physical packaged inventory does not establish made-to-order capacity; that authority remains separate.
Reservation holds are not physical movements; no reservation execution, reconciliation, capacity consumption, or FOOD-005L acceptance creation.
No fulfillment/handoff removal, sale semantics, checkout/payment readiness, routes, services, runtime configuration, or deployment.
deferred: Trusted physical movement execution and authentication
Stocked SKU capacity derivation pending QOH, provenance, and reservation accounting policy
validation: Synthetic-only focused Y tests, X+Y regression, complete FOOD suite, bounded strict TypeScript, zero-warning lint, specification parse, unchanged migrations, exact scope and UTF-8 hygiene.
delivery: Exactly three new unstaged files; no canonical edits, staging, commit, push, migration execution, production mutation, deployment, or FOOD-005Z.
